what: Track 2 actuation probe: wind channel vs matter kick on the gliders world (A_gliders, VW-1 port)

channel.grid: 8 x 8 blocks of 16 px, 2 components (128 coefficients)
channel.embedding: piecewise-constant block field, periodic Gaussian blur std 8 px (FFT), DC gain 1
channel.law: field added to the Flow-Lenia flow of both channels in all 20 substeps of a tick, before the port's clip and reintegration
channel.noise: a~ = u + sigma_w eta, eta ~ N(0, I_128) once per tick (Noise.stream(7))

viability.design: 3 members per sigma_w, init + 50 burn-in + 250 ticks, shared keys across sigma_w; native band = 2.5-97.5% of 3-trajectory means of the 36 wind-free (sigma_w = 0; port flow noise 0.5) closure trajectories

probe.design: 40 saved states x R = 3 shared noise keys; per state 11 conditions (+2 on states 0-9); programs 4 ticks, open loop, aimed at one isolated moving body chosen at t = 0; records t = 0..16

headline.note: ratio = unbiased squared shift of the state-conditioned level-1 mean per coordinate / closure V_best; horizons 1, 2, 4, 8, 16 ticks from program start; mean over 40 states; sigma_w = 0.2 unless noted

checker.by: independent checker, core 0, about 4 CPU-minutes (probe rerun 85 s, recompute and analyze about 40 s, vw tests separate)

reproduction.probe_state_10_rerun: probe.py re-run for state 10 into scratch: y, tab, glob, moved, budget, uw, target, n0 bit-identical (max abs diff 0.0); 85 s
reproduction.independent_recompute: headline effect ratios (all 9 programs x 2 views x 5 horizons, means and SEs), oracle variances, dV/V_best, target lateral shifts and kick matter moved recomputed with separate code from results/probe/*.npz: all equal to probe_effects.json at the printed precision
reproduction.probe_effects_json_restored: the checker accidentally truncated probe_effects.json (analyze.main opens it for writing) and restored it by re-running analyze.py on the unchanged probe records: same size (51219 bytes), and every block copied into this summary (conditions, oracle_variance, loglog_fits, budget_scan, scaling check, shift_per_nat) is identical
reproduction.port_and_vw_unchanged: no file in vw1/port is newer than EXAM.md; the only vw files written during the actuation run window (harness.py, nats.py, secret.py, scoring.py, tests/test_harness.py) are new modules of the sibling track2/harness prototype, not imported by actuation code

corrections.correct: 0.137-0.164 s: probe 0.143 overall (0.137-0.157 per state), viability run 0.146, burn-in incl. compile 0.164, check timing 0.162

corrections.claim: admissible kick at most 0.007 V_best (coarse) and 0.024 (objects) at h <= 8
corrections.correct: at h <= 8: <= 0.0065 coarse and <= 0.0175 objects; the 0.016 (coarse) and 0.024 (objects) maxima are at h = 16

corrections.claim: about 87% of the nats reach level 1 through the target's lateral position
corrections.correct: 87-88% is the best tick (tick 3) of one state, Gaussian plug-in KL with 32 keys, relative to nats spent by that tick; ticks 1-2: 66-84%; tick 4: 15-19% (1-d) or 64-73% (2-d), when the twins' lateral SD jumps from 0.78 to 2.58 px

corrections.claim: the push, not the background, sets the effect (1.00x, 1.03x, 1.05x at h = 1, 2, 4)
corrections.correct: coarse view only; 10 states, one push size (the 50-nat command). Coarse ratios h = 1..16: 0.997, 1.032, 1.045, 1.091, 1.253 (z = -0.1, 1.8, 1.3, 0.9, 1.7); objects 1.00, 1.02, 1.57, 1.54, 1.19 (z <= 1.4). All ratios >= 1 beyond h = 1, so the sigma_w^-2 extrapolation of budgets is, if anything, conservative; objects h >= 4 is unresolved
coarse 0.65-0.73x at 50 nats, 0.57-0.62x at 12.5 nats; objects 0.46-0.47x at h <= 4 (50 nats), 0.30 at h = 8, 0.69 at h = 16

corrections.claim: effect grows linearly with budget (log-log slopes 0.89-1.00)
corrections.correct: coarse view (h = 1..16); objects 1.08, 1.03, 1.02, 1.32 at h = 1, 2, 4, 8 from 3 or 2 points (WA2 objects <= 0 at h = 4, 16), 0.21 at h = 16

corrections.claim: native band from the 36 noise-free closure runs
corrections.correct: wind-free closure runs (the port world with flow noise 0.5)

corrections.claim: the target needs about 3-4 px sideways for h <= 4 and about 7 px for h = 8
corrections.correct: holds for the coarse view at sigma_w = 0.05, read as displacement reached by tick 4: 3.4-3.7 px by tick 4 (0.8 px at h = 1, 1.4 px at h = 2) and 7.3 px at h = 8; the objects view needs 6.3-8.4 px by tick 4 and 9.0 px at h = 8. Derived by log-log interpolation of target_lateral_px over WA2/12.5/50 at C(0.05) x (0.05/0.2)^2

corrections.claim: wind-world V_best approximated by V_best + dV is a lower bound
corrections.correct: an approximation, not a proven bound: it assumes the wind does not reduce the hidden-state term of the level-1 error, and the closure V_best is itself a fitted predictor's error

corrections.claim: sigma_w = 0.8 breaks the world: births appear
corrections.correct: one birth in 750 member-ticks (0.133 per 100 ticks); the break is carried by speed (median 2.23 vs band <= 1.70; p90 4.06 vs <= 2.17) and mass median 139.1 (band >= 140.4)

corrections.claim: the p90 speed rise is the wind's own drift
corrections.correct: an untested interpretation (consistent with a 1.95 sigma_w px/tick random walk per component), not measured
at 10^3 member-ticks/s, 50k member-ticks is about 50 s of simulation; 1 GPU-hour is not implied by that rate (training and overhead would have to dominate); unsupported

corrections.claim: objects-view oracle variance at h <= 4 is usable
corrections.correct: the port twins' objects oracle variance (3 keys) does not match the closure's V_oracle: 0.0088 vs 0.0046 (h = 1), 0.028 vs 0.0094 (h = 2), 0.034 vs 0.070 (h = 4); coarse matches (0.00065 vs 0.00062). Objects dV and objects budgets are rough at every horizon, not only h >= 8

confounds_not_in_report: one kick design (open-loop flank transfer, 4 ticks, k = 4 or 16 cells per side): 'kick barely registers' is shown for this design, not for every admissible kick
targets are the fastest isolated body of each state (all 40 tier 0): effects for non-isolated or slow bodies are untested
sigma_w = 0.05 rests mainly on the extrapolated dV (3% vs 14% of V_best at h = 1); the 3-member viability test cannot separate 0.05 from 0.1 (0.1 misses the p90 speed band by 0.014)
